about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A licensed team with a proven track record in fire safety
about.introText: Fire Advisor is a fire safety engineering and consulting firm with 8+ years of experience on the Bulgarian market. Based in Plovdiv, we work across sectors including manufacturing, retail, hospitality, healthcare and public buildings — nationwide.
about.credKiipText: Chamber of Engineers in Investment Design — a guarantee of professional design qualification.
about.credGdpznText: Permit for fire safety protection and maintenance of active fire safety measures — fire detection and suppression installations, smoke and heat extraction ventilation systems.
about.credExperienceText: Long-standing practical experience in designing and solving fire safety cases.
about.philosophyText: Fire safety isn't a box to tick on a checklist — it's a responsibility to the people who walk into a building every day, and to the owner who's accountable for it. That's why we don't work from templates: every building gets an individual analysis based on how it's actually used, not just the minimum requirements on paper. We aim for solutions that hold up to an inspector's review and to a real emergency — not just to paperwork.
